info.title: WP Sender Developer API
info.description:
Welcome to the WP Sender API documentation. This interactive console allows you to test and integrate our services into your applications.

### Authentication
Most API endpoints require authentication using an **API Key**. 
- Include the `X-API-Key` header with your personal key in every request.
- You can also use **Bearer Token** authentication obtained after logging in through the dashboard.

### Base URL
All requests should be made to: `http://localhost:5000/api` (or your production API URL).

post.summary: Create a new external chat link
post.description: Generate a new secure link for external visitors to chat with you via WhatsApp. Requires a strong password.

session_id.description: The WhatsApp session ID to use for sending/receiving messages.

name.description: A descriptive name for this link (e.g., 'Customer Support Link').

password.description: A secure password that visitors must enter to access the chat.

chat_id.description: (Optional) Specify a target phone number or group ID to lock this link to a single conversation. If omitted, the visitor can start a new chat.

agent_name.description: (Optional) The name of the agent that will be displayed in the chat interface.

limit.description: Maximum allowed contacts based on plan

message.description: Optional custom template. If omitted, the saved template from your dashboard settings will be used. Must include {OTP} placeholder if provided.
message.example: Your security code is {OTP}. Do not share it.

session_id.description: Optional: Specific Session ID to send from. Aliases: sessionId.

post.summary: Send a single or bulk message (supports media)
post.description: Send text or media messages. Use `application/json` for plain text and `multipart/form-data` for file uploads.

recipients.description: Recipient number(s). Can be a string or array.

contentType.description: Type of content to send. Default is 'string' for text messages.

oneOf.description: For 'MessageMediaFromURL', this is the direct URL string.

mimetype.description: نوع الملف (MIME Type). الحدود القصوى للحجم: الصور (JPEG/PNG) بحد أقصى 3MB، ملفات PDF بحد أقصى 8MB، الملفات الأخرى (Excel, Word, Video) بحد أقصى 10MB.

content.description: Content payload. Required for MessageMedia and MessageMediaFromURL.

sender_number.description: Optional: Specific Session ID or phone number to send from.

no_duplication.description: If true, prevents sending if the absolute last message to this recipient was identical. / منع تكرار الإرسال إذا كانت آخر رسالة متطابقة.

post.description: Cancels a running or pending bulk messaging job
Resumes a paused or failed bulk messaging job from where it left off

Send interactive WhatsApp messages. Supports **two formats**:

1. **Button Messages** (Legacy): Up to 3 clickable buttons
2. **List Messages** (New): Sections with multiple options and descriptions

The API automatically detects which format to use based on the request body. The session sleep system automatically wakes sleeping sessions before sending.

text.description: Main message text (what the user sees above the buttons)

get.summary: Check if a phone number is registered on WhatsApp
get.description: Verifies if the provided phone number exists on WhatsApp. This check uses a connected WhatsApp session. If no `sessionId` is provided, the system defaults to your primary connected session.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Phone number to check (with country code, e.g., 201012345678)

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Optional: Specific session ID to use for the check. If omitted, uses the first connected session.

503.description: Session disconnected or WhatsApp API error

post.description: Simulates a typing status in the specified WhatsApp chat. If no sessionId is provided, the system will automatically use your first connected session. This status lasts for approximately 25 seconds or until a message is sent.

sessionId.description: Optional: Session ID. If omitted, uses first connected session.

get.summary: List all WhatsApp sessions with statistics
get.description: Returns a list of all your WhatsApp sessions, including their connection status and usage statistics (messages sent, successful, failed, and OTP counts).

get.summary: Get specific session details and statistics
get.description: Returns details for a specific WhatsApp session, including connection status and usage statistics.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The numeric ID or the UUID (session_id) of the session

post.description: Starts the process of creating a new WhatsApp session. Sub-accounts can also use this if they haven't reached their session limit.

delete.description: Disconnects the session from WhatsApp and marks it as deleted in the system. The record remains in the database for history but is hidden and unusable.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The numeric ID or the UUID (session_id) of the session

post.description: Attempts to restart a disconnected WhatsApp session. This is useful if the session has stopped or failed to start initially.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The numeric ID or the UUID (session_id) of the session

get.summary: Get session QR code (Image or Data)
get.description: Retrieves the QR code for a session. Supports multiple output formats: binary image, base64 data URL, or raw string. Base64 and Image formats are fetched from our secure backend proxy to ensure privacy. ### Authentication for Images To use this endpoint in an `` tag, you can pass the API key or token as a query parameter: `?output=image&apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY`

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The numeric ID or the UUID (session_id) of the session

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output format. 'image' returns binary PNG, 'base64' returns JSON with base64 dataUrl, 'raw' returns the QR string.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Optional: API Key for authentication (useful for tags)

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional: JWT Token for authentication (useful for tags)

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Force refresh the QR code from the WhatsApp API

204.description: QR code not available yet (session might be connecting or already connected)

post.description: Requests a phone number pairing code for a session that is in the 'waiting' or 'qrcode' status.

get.description: Returns the current status of the WhatsApp session (e.g., 'connected', 'disconnected', 'qrcode', 'stopped').
